Let's talk about your business

How we work on your project

You can engage each service separately, according to your needs. Before moving forward, we agree on scope, deliverables, budget and responsibilities.

Understand before choosing

We review your processes and tools. We assess what to configure, connect or build to improve your operations.

What you receive

An assessment with priorities and a reasoned recommendation.

Define the scope

We agree on what the solution must address, who will use it and how to validate it. We define an initial version and what could come next.

What you receive

A documented scope and clear criteria for development.

Build and launch

We build and test the solution with the people who know your operations. We validate workflows and integrations against the agreed scope.

What you receive

The agreed version, validated and documented, with a handover to your team.

Support operations

We keep the solution running with a monthly work capacity agreed around your team's needs.

What's included

Incident response, maintenance and minor adjustments within the agreed capacity.

Explore how we work in detail

Your solution, on the same infrastructure used by the world's largest companies.

We build on Amazon Web Services, the cloud platform behind companies like Netflix, Airbnb and NASA. Not because it's the best known, but because it offers industry-leading availability, security and scalability standards — with certifications such as ISO 27001, SOC 2 and GDPR compliance.

This means your solution runs with the same reliability as leading companies' technology, without you having to manage any of that infrastructure. We take care of it.

See how we applied it at ConsorcioAbierto

AWS Shield

Enterprise-grade security

Standards and certifications that meet the most demanding regulations worldwide.

Elastic Load Balancing

High availability

Infrastructure designed to run without interruptions, with automatic redundancy.

AWS Auto Scaling

Capacity that adapts to your usage

Grow when your business needs it, without paying for what you don't use.

AWS Cost Explorer

Usage-based costs

AWS charges for what you actually use. No idle servers or fixed licenses: the infrastructure adapts to your operations, not the other way around.
